Claudia Murphy Founder of The Cozy Quill · Curated reads, bookish gifts & Blind Date with a Book
About
Every dream starts somewhere. The Cozy Quill started with one shelf. I'm Claudia Murphy, founder of The Cozy Quill — a founder-led, woman-owned, creative-driven café and lifestyle brand built around books, brews and belonging, based in Perth, Western Australia. The idea was born in 2025 from two things that have always gone together in my life: growing up in a Portuguese family where food, conversation and connection were intertwined, and a lifelong love of books. Put them together and you get what The Cozy Quill is built on: books, coffee and community. WHAT YOU'LL FIND AT THE COZY QUILL: • Curated book selections, hand-picked one read at a time • Bookish gifts and greeting cards, printed in Perth • The signature Blind Date with a Book range — wrapped, hinted at, ready to surprise you • Custom gift bundles, made to order WHERE YOU'LL FIND US: Pop-ups and markets around Perth. Since our very first market stall in July 2026, The Cozy Quill has returned to the Scarborough Farmers Market, our products have hit the shelves at Lollipop Collective Perth, and the City of Belmont featured us for their Community Markets in Kambarang. THE BIGGER DREAM: A permanent bookstore café where readers can linger over coffee, join book clubs, attend author events and find a comfortable corner to belong. That is the destination. Until then, the dream keeps growing — one shelf, one market stall, one customer, one brave little step at a time. If you'd like to talk — a market, a stockist arrangement, a collaboration, a custom order, or simply to swap book recommendations — send me a message here on LinkedIn, or follow the journey on Instagram: @thecozyquills.
Fits the 2,600-character limit as-is.

Good questions.

Is this really free?

Yes. No invoice, no catch. Think of it as a sample of my work: you keep everything either way.

Why me?

I rebuild LinkedIn profiles for founders and makers. You already did the hard part — building The Cozy Quill; I arranged it so the first glance tells that story.

Can I edit your copy?

Please do. It's a starting point; your voice is the final judge.

What if I don't like it?

Keep the parts you like, skip the rest. No hard feelings. The files are still yours.

How do I get all this onto my profile?

Every section has a copy button: copy, paste into LinkedIn, done. Your banner and photo files arrive by email at full size, ready to upload.
